_about: The planet sizes a match can pick (A1, Orb 2026-11-13: five sizes; docs/world/planet-sizes.md; read by sim/world/size.gd). A size is the planet's columns round (cols; a column is 32 units, so a size is a distance, and every speed and every body stays as it is), the longest great-circle ring a fight is played on (arenaCols: past it the swing and the arena shift carry the fight round the world), and the bake's spacing in 128-unit nodes (bakeStride, 4 is 512 units). medium is today's planet exactly. A setup picks one by name (planetSize); the hand-made world and a setup with no planet are always medium. offered: a size a player can reach, in the menu and by a setup's planetSize; a size that is not offered plays medium, with an error, whoever names it (a replay, a probe), so held means unreachable. Only medium is offered; tiny, small, big and huge are held until their look is proven, colossal is unproven data. spawnReach (every size but medium): the spawn pair is within this many units (a base send's reach) of a town or city, or the touch point is the nearest of its tries (Game Design, planet-sizes.md). maxBuildingShare (tiny and small only): no building is taller than this share of the planet's radius (Game Design, planet-sizes.md: structures stay under the fight's play height and inside a two-fighter frame; 0.3 of tiny's 6,519 is 1,956, of small's 13,038 is 3,911; the tallest building today is 4,875). Art's look call: a proposal as data.
